sentences.text: 6. Learned ASC for State submits that as the investigations were being concluded, the Prosecutrix made another statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C, wherein she has leveled allegations of rape and Section 376 IPC has been added, which is being investigated.
7. The Petitioner has sought the interim protection/stay in a Petition filed for quashing of the FIR which was registered under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.

As per the submissions of the Petitioner,
himself he had been issued Notices under Section 41.1 Cr.P.C and he had duly joined the investigations.

However, since now the allegations of rape have emerged, it requires a re- look and the Petitioner is entitled to seek his interim protection.
8. No Interim Protection can be granted in a Petition filed for quashing of FIR under Section 498A/406/34 IPC, when additional prima facie investigations are being carried out for the offence under Section 376 IPC.
9.
The Application is accordingly disposed of.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J NOVEMBER 7, 2025/va
